steps.code:
# I can see the files are in the format `<date>__<file_name>.<extension>`. I need to reorganize them to `<file_name>/<date>.<extension>`. Let me parse each file and create the necessary directories, then move the files.

import os

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings_data/"
for file_path in files:
    # Extract the filename from the full path
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    # Split by "__" to get date and rest
    parts = filename.split("__", 1)
    date = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]
    # Split rest into name and extension
    name, ext = os.path.splitext(rest)
    
    # Create directory for the file_name
    dir_path = f"{base_dir}{name}/"
    apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=access_token, recursive=True)
    
    # Move the file to the new location
    dest_path = f"{dir_path}{date}{ext}"
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=dest_path, access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Moved {filename} -> {name}/{date}{ext}: {result}")
